title: Unit Event — The Phoenix in the Distant Sky — Episode7 Beyond Me

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky
meta.Event Outline: At the Otoris' suggestion, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are set to perform in the Phoenix Stage's 30th Anniversary Show. What's more, they'll be performing a show starred in by Tsukasa's idol. Tsukasa leaps at the chance to audition for the same role as him!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Thank you, Phoenix...
I'll never forget about you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“For now, farewell!
I promise to visit your forest again someday!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...is how it goes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still haven't been able to express what Rio's feeling, which makes my portrayal seem superficial... But I can't figure out what I'm missing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to hear what you all think. Please, I'm all ears!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hmmm...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did a really good job just now...
I'm not sure you did anything wrong...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure either...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it does seem like something is missing whenever you're on stage with Sakurako...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Rui...?
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This problem is by no means going to be easy to solve...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In terms of playing a character, this is one of your best portrayals to date...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've taken everything that you experienced until this point, as well as Seiryuin's advice, and dug deep to become this character.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. I'm having trouble thinking of anything that's missing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, once you reach a certain level, it becomes difficult to climb higher. This isn't exclusive to just actors...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As such, not many are able to break through that ceiling. So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree completely...
You might've been able to find an answer, if only you had a little bit more time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we may be able to come up with something if we all put our heads together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's brainstorm!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even a small idea might help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She's right. I'm willing to accept even the smallest idea if it means being able to find a way forward...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is so difficult!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This situation we're in...
It feels a lot like the show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Which part?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember what happens during the climax? The boy finds himself at a total loss after struggling to catch the phoenix!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right now, you seem a little similar to the boy during that scene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio during that scene...and I...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She may be right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Why can't I catch you...?
Why am I so weak and powerless...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My current situation and Rio's during that scene do seem to mirror each other.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We both desperately seek something, but neither of us possesses the power to attain what we're after.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This sense of powerlessness that's welling up inside of me... If I can connect that to what Rio's feeling during that scene...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
That's it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is it, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I just have to take a look at my phoenix...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
Your phoenix...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you figure something out just now, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
The chances are slim, but this may allow me to figure out my character...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So...
What I said worked?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I believe it did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(You can do it, Tsukasa...
I'm sure you'll be able to clear a path forward...)
The next day
Tokyo Century Hall

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... Row G, seats 15 to 18...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, found them!
These are our seats!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting these tickets to come in handy like this. You initially thought that you wouldn't be able to make it, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really happy for you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, he seems really focused...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I should leave him alone!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last saw Mr. Amami perform...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll never forget what I saw that time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After that, he began working abroad, and even started receiving chances to be a director and playwright. As a result, I haven't been able to see him perform on stage much...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I finally get to see him again today.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm not just here to watch the show and enjoy myself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If this doesn't help me figure out how to play Rio, that'll be it for me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, focus...!)

“Hm? What's wrong?
Why the long face?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That voice... Was it talking about me...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, that can't be right.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But it sure sounded that way...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, he seems to be trying to reach each person in the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And he appears to be doing it effortlessly. That's quite a feat considering this hall seats 2,000 people...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's up there all alone with no props or anything... And he just started talking, but already has such a huge presence...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That person's just standing there all by himself, but he's so sparkly...!
“Alright, the curtains are about to go up.”

“By the time they fall again...
My hope is that you will be unable to contain your joy and excitement.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Such brilliance.)

“Curious...
Just seeing you walk is making me fall in love with this path. Just looking at the flowers that grow beside it makes me think of you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My eyes can't help but be drawn to him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (With each word he utters, I look forward to hearing what he's going to say next...)

“Ah...
One day, simply seeing this land will end up filling me with happiness.”

“I'm exaggerating...?
No, I don't believe I am...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The way he smiles, where he looks and each subtle gesture... He's making all of the right moves...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's bringing his character to life so organically... No, not a character! He's real...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is Seiichi Amami...
The person I look up to. A true...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A true...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I was little, before I knew anything about theatre, he was who I admired.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, perhaps even after I began to study acting... For so long, I was sure that I'd be able to get closer to his level.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, because I've been learning and absorbing so much lately, I can see now that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even a stage that wouldn't take me ten seconds to walk to...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's beyond my grasp...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No... No, don't look away...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Do not let this sensation go...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This sense of powerlessness...
Feel what it's like to be unable to attain what you are after!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No matter how much I practice... No matter how hard I try, I fall short of those around me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I've been running and running...
But I'm struggling to catch up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's like that phoenix flying high in the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess that is what you want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You want to reach that sky...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: T-Tsukasa, are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should let Tsukasa be right now...
After the show

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That was so good!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, it really was.
It sorta felt like a dream, you know?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Here...
You can use my handkerchief.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you see that phoenix you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I saw it.
The phoenix I'd been admiring, seeking and chasing after...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I apologize for causing you all so much trouble like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm going to practice while this feeling is still fresh in my mind! Will you help me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Do you really think we're going to refuse after coming this far?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, at this point, we're all in the same boat and it's already set sail...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeaaahhh!!!
Let's practice lots and lots starting right now!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
I promise to put on the best performance you've ever seen!!!
